title: Unbounded banded matrices, shifted positive bidiagonal factorizations, and mixed-type multiple orthogonality
summary: This work extends Favard-type spectral representations for banded matrices $T$ beyond the bounded setting. It assumes that, for every $N\in\mathbb N_0$, there exists a shift $s_N\ge 0$ such that the shifted truncation $A_N:= T^{[N]}+s_N I_{N+1}$ admits a positive bidiagonal factorization (PBF). Allowing $s_N$ to depend on $N$ leads to a natural recentering step: the discrete Gauss-type quadrature measures associated with $A_N$ are translated by $x\mapsto x-s_N$, producing a uniformly bounded family of distribution functions.
